// A populated old application's schema/data/auth survive upgrade, real backup restore and re-upgrade.
import { mkdtempSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import Database from "better-sqlite3";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { buildApp } from "../src/app.ts";
import { insertItem } from "../src/features/loans/items.repository.ts";
import { loadConfig } from "../src/platform/config.ts";
import { openDb } from "../src/platform/db.ts";
import { migrate } from "../src/platform/migrate.ts";
import { restore } from "../src/platform/restore.ts";
import { buildSchemaV1, priorNow, priorPassword } from "./fixtures/schema-v1.ts";
import { signIn } from "./helpers.ts";

it("preserves a frozen schema-1 account/session through loan upgrade, backup restore and re-upgrade [QLT-07, QLT-12]", async () => {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "starter-prior-version-")), path = join(dir, "app.db");
  const config = loadConfig({ NODE_ENV: "test", LOG_LEVEL: "silent", DATABASE_URL: path });
  const prior = buildSchemaV1(path, config.cookieSecret);
  const db = openDb(path);
  try {
    expect(migrate(db).applied).toEqual(["0002_items_loans.sql"]);
    expect(db.prepare("SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id").all()).toEqual(prior.users);
    expect(db.prepare("SELECT * FROM sessions ORDER BY id").all()).toEqual(prior.sessions);
    expect(db.prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").all()).toEqual([]);
    const backups = readdirSync(dir).filter(name => name.endsWith(".bak"));
    expect(backups).toHaveLength(1);
    const copy = join(dir, backups[0]!);
    const old = new Database(copy, { readonly: true });
    try {
      expect(old.prepare("SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id").all()).toEqual(prior.users);
      expect(old.prepare("SELECT * FROM sessions ORDER BY id").all()).toEqual(prior.sessions);
      expect(old.prepare("SELECT version FROM schema_migrations").all()).toEqual([{ version: "0001_init.sql" }]);
      expect(old.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'loans'").get()).toBeUndefined();
      expect(old.prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").all()).toEqual([]);
    } finally { old.close(); }
    insertItem(db, { id: "upgraded-item", name: "Upgraded microscope", created_at: priorNow });
    const app = await buildApp(config, { db, now: () => priorNow + 100 });
    let loanId: string;
    try {
      await app.ready();
      const me = await app.inject({ method: "GET", url: "/api/auth/me", cookies: { sid: prior.cookie } });
      expect(me.statusCode).toBe(200);
      expect(me.json().user).toEqual({ id: "prior-member", email: "prior.member@example.test", role: "member" });
      expect((await signIn(app, "prior.member@example.test", priorPassword)).res.statusCode).toBe(200);
      const reserved = await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: "/api/items/upgraded-item/reserve", cookies: { sid: prior.cookie }, headers: { "x-csrf-token": prior.csrf } });
      expect(reserved.statusCode).toBe(200); loanId = reserved.json().id;
    } finally { await app.close(); }
    db.close();
    const result = restore(copy, path);
    expect(result.schemaVersion).toBe("0001_init.sql");
    const kept = new Database(result.keptAside!, { readonly: true });
    try {
      expect(kept.prepare("SELECT user_id FROM loans WHERE id = ?").get(loanId!)).toEqual({ user_id: "prior-member" });
      expect(kept.prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").all()).toEqual([]);
    } finally { kept.close(); }
    const restored = openDb(path);
    try {
      expect(restored.prepare("SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id").all()).toEqual(prior.users);
      expect(restored.prepare("SELECT * FROM sessions ORDER BY id").all()).toEqual(prior.sessions);
      expect(migrate(restored, { backupTo: join(dir, "before-reapply.bak") }).applied).toEqual(["0002_items_loans.sql"]);
      expect(migrate(restored).applied).toEqual([]);
      expect(restored.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans").get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
      expect(restored.prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").all()).toEqual([]);
      const restarted = await buildApp(config, { db: restored, now: () => priorNow + 200 });
      try {
        await restarted.ready();
        expect((await restarted.inject({ method: "GET", url: "/api/auth/me", cookies: { sid: prior.cookie } })).statusCode).toBe(200);
        expect((await signIn(restarted, "prior.member@example.test", priorPassword)).res.statusCode).toBe(200);
      } finally { await restarted.close(); }
    } finally { restored.close(); }
  } finally { if (db.open) db.close(); rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
